name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
steps: Stand or sit tall with your shoulders relaxed and pulled back.
Bring your target arm straight across your chest at upper-chest height.
Use your opposite hand to grasp your target arm just above the elbow.
Gently pull your arm closer into your chest until you feel a firm, comfortable stretch in the back of your shoulder.
Hold the stretch steady for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing normally.
Slowly release the tension and repeat on the opposite arm.
coaching_cues: Keep your target shoulder blade down and back; avoid shrugging the shoulder up toward your chin.
Do not twist your torso; keep your chest facing directly forward.
Apply gentle, consistent pressure without bouncing.
